mapper.sql:
WITH scoped AS ( SELECT id, tenant_id, occurred_at, details FROM audit_event WHERE ), parsed AS ( SELECT id AS event_id, tenant_id, occurred_at, CASE WHEN details->>'requestId' ~ '^([a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}|hash-[a-f0-9]{20})$' THEN details->>'requestId' END AS request_id, CASE WHEN details->>'workflowId' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{20}$' THEN details->>'workflowId' END AS workflow_id, CASE WHEN details->>'operation' IN ('prompt.optimize', 'plan.generate', 'document.summary.map', 'document.summary.reduce', 'context.embedding') THEN details->>'operation' ELSE 'unknown' END AS operation, CASE WHEN details->>'providerRoute' ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,128}$' AND strpos(details->>'providerRoute', '://') = 0 THEN details->>'providerRoute' ELSE 'unknown' END AS provider_route, CASE WHEN details->>'model' ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,128}$' AND strpos(details->>'model', '://') = 0 THEN details->>'model' ELSE 'unknown' END AS model, CASE WHEN details->>'attempt' ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' THEN greatest(1, least(100, (details->>'attempt')::int)) ELSE 1 END AS attempt, COALESCE(details->>'mock' = 'true', false) AS mock, COALESCE(details->>'successful' = 'true', false) AS successful, CASE WHEN details->>'failureType' IN ('AUTHENTICATION', 'RATE_LIMIT', 'TIMEOUT', 'REQUEST_REJECTED', 'UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE', 'INVALID_RESPONSE', 'CONFIGURATION', 'INTERNAL', 'RESOURCE_ACCESS', 'UNEXPECTED', 'MODEL_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT') THEN details->>'failureType' END AS failure_type, CASE WHEN details->>'upstreamStatus' ~ '^[1-5][0-9]{2}$' THEN (details->>'upstreamStatus')::int END AS upstream_status, COALESCE(details->>'willRetry' = 'true', false) AS will_retry, CASE WHEN details->>'transportState' IN ('MOCK', 'NOT_SENT', 'STARTED', 'RESPONSE_RECEIVED') THEN details->>'transportState' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS transport_state, CASE WHEN details->>'cacheState' IN ('HIT', 'MISS', 'MIXED', 'NONE') THEN details->>'cacheState' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS cache_state, details->>'usageState' AS reported_usage_state, CASE WHEN details->>'durationMs' ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$' THEN (details->>'durationMs')::bigint ELSE 0 END AS duration_ms, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(details->'inputTokens') = 'number' AND details->>'inputTokens' ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN CASE WHEN (details->>'inputTokens')::numeric <= 9223372036854775807 THEN (details->>'inputTokens')::numeric END END AS input_tokens, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(details->'outputTokens') = 'number' AND details->>'outputTokens' ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN CASE WHEN (details->>'outputTokens')::numeric <= 9223372036854775807 THEN (details->>'outputTokens')::numeric END END AS output_tokens, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(details->'totalTokens') = 'number' AND details->>'totalTokens' ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN CASE WHEN (details->>'totalTokens')::numeric <= 9223372036854775807 THEN (details->>'totalTokens')::numeric END END AS total_tokens, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(details->'cacheHitTokens') = 'number' AND details->>'cacheHitTokens' ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN CASE WHEN (details->>'cacheHitTokens')::numeric <= 9223372036854775807 THEN (details->>'cacheHitTokens')::numeric END END AS cache_hit_tokens, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(details->'cacheMissTokens') = 'number' AND details->>'cacheMissTokens' ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN CASE WHEN (details->>'cacheMissTokens')::numeric <= 9223372036854775807 THEN (details->>'cacheMissTokens')::numeric END END AS cache_miss_tokens, details FROM scoped ), calls AS ( SELECT *,
CASE WHEN reported_usage_state = 'INVALID' OR (input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND output_tokens IS NOT NULL AND total_tokens IS NOT NULL AND input_tokens + output_tokens != total_tokens) OR (input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_hit_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_hit_tokens > input_tokens) OR (input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_miss_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_miss_tokens > input_tokens) OR (input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_hit_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_miss_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_hit_tokens + cache_miss_tokens != input_tokens) THEN 'INVALID' WHEN input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND output_tokens IS NOT NULL AND total_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETE' WHEN input_tokens IS NOT NULL OR output_tokens IS NOT NULL OR total_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS usage_state FROM parsed )
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, tenant_id, occurred_at, request_id, workflow_id, operation, provider_route, model, attempt, mock, successful, failure_type, upstream_status, will_retry, transport_state, usage_state, CASE WHEN usage_state = 'INVALID' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE cache_state END AS cache_state, input_tokens::bigint, output_tokens::bigint, total_tokens::bigint, cache_hit_tokens::bigint, cache_miss_tokens::bigint, duration_ms FROM calls WHERE ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, event_id DESC
